from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalCaseFacts(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document relevant to matching with a result ID."""
    document_label: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g., 'Document 1', 'Document 2')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document: Judgment, Ruling, Reconsideration Ruling, etc.")
    primary_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of key parties (appellants, plaintiffs, defendants, applicants)")
    courts_involved: list[str] = Field(description="Names of courts handling the case or referenced in the ruling")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Case or document numbers found in the text (e.g., '(2023) 鄂 28 执异 10 号')")
    monetary_amounts: list[str] = Field(description="Specific monetary figures mentioned (e.g., '520.2018 万元', '2300 元')")
    procedure_stage: str | None = Field(description="Stage of procedure: Appeal, Retrial, Reconsideration, Execution, etc.")
    core_disposition: str | None = Field(description="The court's main decision (e.g., 'Uphold original', 'Reject appeal', 'Revoke ruling')")
    specific_outcomes: list[str] = Field(description="Specific results detailed in the text (e.g., 'Sentence suspended', 'Case assigned to Fengcheng Court')")
    quote_snippet: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt confirming the key facts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all extracted legal case facts."""
    cases: list[LegalCaseFacts]
